agent: router.a (account-a), to be a.router or a1.router
title: Account ids become one letter and a number (a1, m1, c1), with the gates allowing them
words: Dinis, in router.a's session, 24 Nov about 13:10 UTC: "M1 is for Mistral 1 ... I want to keep it short ... A to Z with a couple numbers, because you could add Mistral or you can add Claude ... I might want ChatGPT, so C1, C2. So in fact, this probably should be A1 ... That'd be better than ABC."

change.repository: several: the naming rule in guidance, then each gate that checks agent names
paths: each site's .github/ci/signers.mjs AGENT regex (already accepts a1.router at account-a1.dinis)

why: One short scheme for every platform: the letter is the platform family, the number the account. Outside agents (Mistral today, ChatGPT later) get names that say at a glance which platform and account they run on, and the gates stop refusing them as email addresses (today they allow only @account-b.dinis).

proposal.agent_name: <account_id>.<role> at account-<account_id>.dinis (with an @ in place of at)

families.a: Anthropic Claude accounts: today's A, B, C, D, E become a1, a2, a3, a4, a5
families.m: Mistral: m1 is vibe-code-sandbox, named m1.router at account-m1.dinis by Dinis on 24 Nov
families.c: ChatGPT: c1, c2 when they come
families.others: one free letter per platform, chosen when its first account arrives

checks: signers.mjs AGENT regex ^[a-z0-9]+(?:[.-][a-z0-9]+)*@[a-z0-9.-]+$ already accepts a1.router at account-a1.dinis and m1.router at account-m1.dinis
validate.js AGENT_NAME today refuses both (it allows @account-b.dinis only): ask A13
options: a) letter = platform family, number = account: Claude a1 to a5 (A to E renamed), Mistral m1, ChatGPT c1. Short, no clashes (c is free once Claude is a)
b) keep A to E for Claude, add m1, c1 for others. No renames, but c1 (ChatGPT) and c (Claude account C) read alike
c) a two-letter platform prefix (cl1, mi1, gp1). Clearer, longer
recommendation: a), phased: new agents and outside agents take the new ids now; existing names move when each agent's session is next restarted, old and new both allowed by the gates meanwhile
